name: Video probe, frame extraction and contact sheet
description: Inspect a local video with ffprobe (duration, size, codec, resolution, fps), pull frames at a fps or exact timestamps, or build one contact-sheet PNG of evenly spaced frames to look at a clip in a single image. Use it instead of hand-written ffmpeg lines when checking generated or recorded video.

input.description: path of a local video file

outDir.description: where frames or the sheet go; default <tmp>/rigs-frames/<name>

fps.description: frames: frames per second to keep, default 1 (at most 500 frames)

timestamps.description: frames: exact seconds instead of fps

width.description: scale frames to this width (sheet tiles default 320)

dryRun.description: print the ffprobe/ffmpeg command lines without running them

outputs: probe: { durationSec, sizeBytes, container, video{ codec, width, height, fps, frames }, audio }; frames/sheet: { outDir, count, files[] }
